Before your visit

What to have ready

A few minutes of prep makes your visit quick and smooth:

  • Your lab order or kitThe requisition from your provider, or your collection kit instructions.
  • Your IDPhoto identification, if your laboratory requires it.
  • Your provider's instructionsFollow their guidance on fasting, medications, and hydration before the draw.
  • A comfortable seatA chair with an armrest in a well-lit spot is all the workspace Cathy needs.
Transparent pricing

Clear pricing. No surprises.

One standard visit includes the travel fee and blood draw service. Additional blood specimens collected during that same visit have no additional collection charge.

Lab testing, shipping, and other third-party charges are not included unless specifically arranged. The total is confirmed before your appointment.

Good to know

Frequently asked questions

Do I need a lab order?

Most diagnostic blood collections require a valid order from your healthcare provider or instructions from your designated lab. Contact us if you're unsure what is needed.

Do you charge extra for more tubes?

No. Additional blood specimens collected during the same standard visit do not add a collection fee. Requests involving multiple patients or specialized handling may require a separate quote.

Are laboratory testing fees included?

No. Let's Get Well charges for the mobile visit and blood collection. Laboratory testing and any third-party fees are separate.

Can I request a weekend appointment?

Yes. Weekend and after-hours requests are reviewed individually and may carry a $35–$75 surcharge. Appointments are not confirmed until Cathy contacts you.

What areas do you serve?

St. Louis and surrounding communities, subject to availability and travel distance. Include your ZIP code in the request so coverage can be confirmed.

How do I prepare?

Have your lab order or kit instructions ready, along with identification if required by the laboratory. Follow your ordering provider's instructions about fasting, medications, and hydration.

Can I book for a parent or family member?

Yes. Caregivers book visits for loved ones all the time. Put your contact details in the request and note that the visit is for a family member, and Cathy will confirm the details with you.

Your next blood draw doesn't need a waiting room.

Call today or send a request, and Cathy will call you back to confirm your time, your location, and your total — before anything is booked.
